name: WalletExplorer (API and address pages)
tier_rationale: Identifiable individual operator with a public keyless API and a long public track record; the council recorded tier community (P208 cond 3 'Registry provider walletexplorer: tier community', P216 cond 5 'community - ... WalletExplorer').

reliability.justification: Bitcoin wallet clustering heuristics with a service-name database not updated since 2016 (per its info page): a label is a lead for a legal request to that service, not proof of ownership (P208 cond 2).

api.title: WalletExplorer API /api/1/address-lookup and /api/1/wallet (caller id)

terms.quote: Registry provider walletexplorer: tier community, terms open.

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P208 cond 3); research C0489 records a free keyless API with attribution, a caller id and moderate use (~1 req/s) (verified_live 200). The API page (checked 2026-11-26): 'You can use it without any API key.' www.walletexplorer.com/api/1/address-lookup?address={a}&caller={caller_id} and /api/1/wallet?wallet={id}&from=0&count=100&caller={caller_id}; caller comes from the operator-identifier setting caller_id, a generic team identifier, never an analyst's name or an investigated value (unset = SKIPPED 'config', P208 cond 1). found:false = EMPTY (P208 cond 2). Used by walletexplorer.

address_pages.title: WalletExplorer address pages (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: Registry provider walletexplorer: tier community, terms open.

address_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (P208 cond 3); research C0506 (verified_live 200). www.walletexplorer.com/address/{btc_address}: manual pivot links only (P216), never fetched. Used by pivots_crypto.

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G09-1, p2-G14-2 (P208, P216): batches only extend it (walletexplorer__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). www.walletexplorer.com serves the API and pages (research C0489/C0506). The author asks for a caller id and moderate use (~1 req/s): min_interval 1 s, one request at a time, no quota block; attribution in reports. ttl 1 h (crypto class).
